1.w: By David. Vindicate me, O Lord, for I have integrity, and I trust in the Lord without wavering.

2.w: Examine me, O Lord, and test me. Evaluate my inner thoughts and motives.

3.w: For I am ever aware of your faithfulness, and your loyalty continually motivates me.

4.w: I do not associate with deceitful men, or consort with those who are dishonest.

5.w: I hate the mob of evil men, and do not associate with the wicked.

6.w: I maintain a pure lifestyle, so I can appear before your altar, O Lord,

7.w: to give you thanks, and to tell about all your amazing deeds.

8.w: O Lord, I love the temple where you live, the place where your splendor is revealed.

9.w: Do not sweep me away with sinners, or execute me along with violent people,

10.w: who are always ready to do wrong or offer a bribe.

11.w: But I have integrity. Rescue me and have mercy on me!

12.w: I am safe, and among the worshipers I will praise the Lord.
